title: Choosing Who Chooses: Selection-Driven Targeting in Energy Rebate Programs
abstract: We develop an optimal policy assignment rule that integrates two distinctive approaches commonly used in economics---targeting by observables and targeting through self-selection . Our method can be used with experimental or quasi-experimental data to identify who should be treated, be untreated, and self-select to achieve a policymaker's objective. Applying this method to a randomized controlled trial on a residential energy rebate program, we find that targeting that optimally exploits both observable data and self-selection outperforms conventional targeting for a utilitarian welfare function as well as welfare functions that balance the equity-efficiency trade-off. We highlight that the Local Average Treatment Effect (LATE) framework (Imbens and Angrist, 1994) can be used to investigate the mechanism behind our approach. By estimating several key LATEs based on the random variation created by our experiment, we demonstrate how our method allows policymakers to identify whose self-selection would be valuable and harmful to social welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种最优政策分配规则，将经济学中两种常用的方法整合起来：基于可观测变量的目标定位，以及通过自选择实现的目标定位。我们的方法可用于实验或准实验数据，以识别应当接受处理者、不应接受处理者，以及会自行选择的人群，从而实现政策制定者的目标。将该方法应用于一项居民能源返还计划的随机对照试验，我们发现，无论是对于功利主义福利函数，还是对于在效率与公平之间进行权衡的福利函数，既能充分利用可观测数据又能利用自选择的最优目标定位，都优于传统的目标定位。我们指出，局部平均处理效应（LATE）框架（Imbens and Angrist, 1994）可用于考察本方法背后的机制。通过基于本实验所产生的随机变异估计若干关键的LATE，我们展示了本方法如何使政策制定者识别出哪些人的自选择对社会福利有益、哪些人的自选择有害。

title: Zero Energy Day: How Nationwide Blackouts Affect the Economy
abstract: Electricity reliability is a central challenge for the energy transition, as growing energy demand, renewable energy integration, and natural disasters increase the risk of large-scale black- outs. However, the economic impacts of large-scale blackouts remain largely unknown. Combining electricity market data with high-frequency economic transaction data from Chile, we find that economic activity declined by 35 percent on the nationwide blackout day, but half of this loss was recovered on subsequent days, highlighting the importance of intertemporal substitution. Exploiting spatial variation in blackout severity, we show that accounting for endogenous recovery is critical when estimating the marginal value of lost load. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 电力可靠性是能源转型面临的核心挑战，因为不断增长的能源需求、可再生能源并网以及自然灾害都会增加大规模停电的风险。然而，大规模停电的经济影响在很大程度上仍然未知。结合智利的电力市场数据与高频经济交易数据，我们发现，在全国性停电当天，经济活动下降了35%，但其中一半的损失在随后几天得以恢复，这凸显了跨期替代的重要性。利用停电严重程度的空间差异，我们表明，在估计损失负荷的边际价值时，考虑内生的恢复过程至关重要。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户及发展中国家的居民可以在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

title: Global Policy Spillovers: How Environmental Policies Propagate through Product Attributes
abstract: How should policymakers evaluate policy impacts when firms design products for global markets? Standard economic analyses typically focus on domestic outcomes, implicitly assuming that policies affect only the jurisdiction in which they are enacted. Yet multinational firms often harmonize product design across markets, creating the potential for policies implemented in one country to generate global spillovers through changes in product attributes. We call this phenomenon "attribute propagation" and develop a framework to measure and assess its quantitative importance. Applying this framework to an environmental policy affecting automobiles, we find that a fuel-economy subsidy in Japan led to significant improvements in the fuel economy of vehicles sold in the United States. We then develop a model of multinational automobile markets featuring cross-market cost complementarity as a key mechanism driving attribute propagation. Using the estimated model, we conduct counterfactual simulations to quantify environmental benefits accounting for the policy’s global spillover effects. We find that global spillover effects are first-order—a majority of the CO2 emissions reductions induced by the Japanese policy arise through its impact on the U.S. automobile market. These findings suggest that standard economic analyses that abstract from attribute propagation can substantially understate the full policy impact. More broadly, attribute propagation provides a new lens for evaluating environmental, safety, antitrust, and technology policies in a global economy. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 当企业为全球市场设计产品时，政策制定者应如何评估政策影响？标准的经济分析通常关注国内结果，隐含地假定政策只影响实施该政策的司法辖区。然而，跨国企业往往在各市场之间统一产品设计，因此一国实施的政策可能通过产品属性的变化产生全球溢出效应。我们将这一现象称为“属性传播”（attribute propagation），并构建了一个框架来衡量和评估其定量重要性。将该框架应用于一项影响汽车的环境政策，我们发现日本的燃油经济性补贴显著提高了在美国销售车辆的燃油经济性。随后，我们构建了一个多国汽车市场模型，其中跨市场成本互补性是驱动属性传播的关键机制。利用估计得到的模型，我们进行反事实模拟，以量化在计入该政策全球溢出效应后的环境效益。我们发现，全球溢出效应是一阶重要的：日本政策所引致的CO2减排中，大部分是通过其对美国汽车市场的影响而实现的。这些发现表明，忽略属性传播的标准经济分析可能大幅低估政策的全部影响。更广泛地看，属性传播为在全球经济中评估环境、安全、反垄断和技术政策提供了一个新的视角。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户及发展中国家的居民可以在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

title: Dynamic Targeting: Experimental Evidence from Energy Rebate Programs
abstract: Economic policies often involve dynamic interventions, where individuals receive repeated interventions over multiple periods. This dynamics makes past responses informative to predict future responses and ultimate outcomes depend on the history of interventions. Despite these phenomena, existing economic studies typically focus on static targeting, possibly overlooking key information from dynamic interventions. We develop a framework for designing optimal dynamic targeting that maximizes social welfare gains from dynamic policy intervention. Our framework can be applied to experimental or quasi-experimental data with sequential randomization. We demonstrate that dynamic targeting can outperform static targeting through several key mechanisms: learning, habit formation, and screening effects. We then propose methods to empirically identify these effects. By applying this method to a randomized controlled trial on a residential energy rebate program, we show that dynamic targeting significantly outperforms conventional static targeting, leading to improved social welfare gains. We observe significant heterogeneity in the learning, habit formation, and screening effects, and illustrate how our approach leverages this heterogeneity to design optimal dynamic targeting.
abstract_zh: 经济政策通常涉及动态干预，即个体在多个时期内反复接受干预。这种动态性使过去的反应能够为预测未来反应提供信息，且最终结果取决于干预的历史。尽管存在这些现象，现有经济学研究通常关注静态目标定位，可能忽略了动态干预中的关键信息。我们构建了一个框架，用于设计最优动态目标定位，以最大化动态政策干预带来的社会福利收益。我们的框架可应用于具有序贯随机化的实验或准实验数据。我们证明，动态目标定位可以通过若干关键机制优于静态目标定位，这些机制包括学习效应、习惯形成效应和筛选效应。随后，我们提出了对这些效应进行实证识别的方法。将该方法应用于一项居民能源返还计划的随机对照试验，我们表明，动态目标定位显著优于传统的静态目标定位，带来了更高的社会福利收益。我们观察到学习效应、习惯形成效应和筛选效应存在显著的异质性，并说明了我们的方法如何利用这种异质性来设计最优动态目标定位。

title: Do Consumers Distinguish Fixed Cost from Variable Cost? “Schmeduling” in Two-Part Tariffs in Energy
abstract: A central assumption in economics is that consumers properly distinguish fixed cost from variable cost. This assumption is fundamental to various economic theories, including optimal taxation, redistribution, and price discrimination. Using a quasi-experiment in heating price reform in China, we find empirical evidence that is inconsistent with this conventional assumption and more consistent with the “schmeduling” model in Liebman and Zeckhauser (2004). As we demonstrate its policy implications for two-part energy tariffs, this schmeduling behavior makes fixed costs directly relevant to the perceived relative prices of goods, and therefore alters the welfare implications of price, tax, and subsidy designs. (JEL D12, D91, H24, L94, O12, P28, P36)
abstract_zh: 经济学中的一个核心假设是，消费者能够正确区分固定成本与可变成本。这一假设是多种经济理论的基础，包括最优税收、再分配和价格歧视。利用中国供暖价格改革的准实验，我们发现了与这一传统假设不一致、而更符合Liebman和Zeckhauser（2004）提出的“schmeduling”模型的经验证据。正如我们在两部制能源电价上所展示的政策含义，这种schmeduling行为使固定成本直接影响消费者感知的商品相对价格，因而改变了价格、税收和补贴设计的福利含义。（JEL D12, D91, H24, L94, O12, P28, P36）

title: Smart Grid Economics: A Field Experimental Approach to Demand Response
Selection on Welfare Gains: Experimental Evidence from Electricity Plan Choice
abstract: We study a problem in which policymakers need to screen self-selected individuals by unobserved heterogeneity in social welfare gains from a policy intervention. In our framework, the marginal treatment effects and marginal treatment responses arise as key statistics to characterize social welfare. We apply this framework to a randomized field experiment on electricity plan choice. Consumers were offered socially efficient dynamic pricing with randomly assigned take-up incentives. We find that price-elastic consumers-who generate larger welfare gains-are more likely to self-select. Our counterfactual simulations quantify the optimal take-up incentives that exploit observed and unobserved heterogeneity in selection and welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 我们研究这样一个问题：政策制定者需要根据未观测到的异质性所带来的社会福利收益，对自选择的个体进行甄别，这些收益来自某项政策干预。在我们的框架中，边际处理效应（marginal treatment effects）和边际处理反应（marginal treatment responses）是刻画社会福利的关键统计量。我们将该框架应用于一项关于电力套餐选择的随机现场实验。消费者被提供社会有效率的动态定价方案，并被随机分配了接受激励。我们发现，对价格敏感、从而产生更大福利收益的消费者，更有可能自行选择。我们的反事实模拟量化了最优接受激励，该激励利用了选择和福利收益中可观测与不可观测的异质性。

title: The Investment Effects of Market Integration: Evidence from Renewable Energy Expansion in Chile
abstract: We study the investment effects of market integration on renewable energy expansion. Our theory highlights that market integration not only improves allocative efficiency by gains from trade but also incentivizes new investment in renewable power plants. To test our theoretical predictions, we examine how recent grid expansions in the Chilean electricity market changed electricity production, wholesale prices, generation costs, and renewable investments. We then build a structural model of power plant entry to quantify the impact of market integration with and without the investment effects. We find that the market integration in Chile increased solar generation by around 180%, saved generation costs by 8%, and reduced carbon emissions by 5%. A substantial amount of renewable entry would not have occurred in the absence of market integration. Our findings suggest that ignoring these investment effects would substantially understate the benefits of market integration and its important role in expanding renewable energy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究市场一体化对可再生能源扩张的投资效应。我们的理论强调，市场一体化不仅通过贸易收益改善了配置效率，还激励了对可再生能源发电厂的新投资。为检验理论预测，我们考察了智利电力市场近期的电网扩张如何改变了发电量、批发价格、发电成本以及可再生能源投资。随后，我们构建了一个发电厂进入的结构模型，以量化考虑与不考虑投资效应时市场一体化的影响。我们发现，智利的市场一体化使太阳能发电量增加了约180%，节约了8%的发电成本，并减少了5%的碳排放。如果不存在市场一体化，大量的可再生能源进入本不会发生。我们的研究结果表明，忽略这些投资效应将大幅低估市场一体化的收益，以及其在扩大可再生能源方面的重要作用。

title: 経済理論と実証分析に基づく電力市場設計 (Electricity market design based on economic theory and empirical analysis)
Willingness to Pay for Clean Air: Evidence from Air Purifier Markets in China
abstract: We develop a framework to estimate willingness to pay (WTP) for clean air from defensive investment. Applying this framework to product-by-store level scanner data on air purifier sales in China, we provide among the first revealed preference estimates of WTP for clean air in developing countries.A spatial discontinuity in air pollution created by the Huai River heating policy enables us to analyze household responses to long-run exposure to pollution. Our model allows heterogeneity in preference parameters to investigate potential heterogeneity in WTP among households. We show that our estimates provide important policy implications for optimal environmental regulation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个框架，用于估计因防御性投资而产生的清洁空气支付意愿（WTP）。将该框架应用于中国空气净化器销售的产品-门店层面扫描数据，我们首次（或属于最早的一批研究）在发展中国家提供了清洁空气支付意愿的显示性偏好估计。淮河供暖政策造成的空气污染空间断点，使我们能够分析家庭对长期污染暴露的反应。我们的模型允许偏好参数存在异质性，以考察家庭之间支付意愿可能存在的异质性。我们表明，这些估计结果对最优环境规制具有重要的政策含义。

title: Moral Suasion and Economic Incentives: Field Experimental Evidence from Energy Demand
abstract: Firms and governments often use moral suasion and economic incentives to influence intrinsic and extrinsic motivations for economic activities. To investigate persistence of such interventions, we randomly assign households to moral suasion and dynamic pricing that stimulate energy conservation during peak-demand hours. We find significant habituation and dishabituation for moral suasion—the treatment effect diminishes after repeated interventions but can be restored to the original level by a sufficient time interval between interventions. Economic incentives induce larger treatment effects, little habituation, and significant habit formation. Our results suggest moral suasion and economic incentives produce substantially different short-run and long-run policy impacts. (JEL C93, D83, L94, L98, Q41, Q48)
abstract_zh: 企业和政府常常利用道德劝说（moral suasion）和经济激励来影响经济活动中的内在动机与外在动机。为考察此类干预的持续性，我们将家庭随机分配至道德劝说组和动态定价组，以在用电高峰时段促进节约用电。我们发现，道德劝说存在显著的习惯化（habituation）与去习惯化（dishabituation）：处理效应在反复干预后会减弱，但只要两次干预之间有足够的时间间隔，效应便可恢复到原有水平。经济激励产生的处理效应更大，几乎不存在习惯化，并表现出显著的习惯形成。我们的结果表明，道德劝说与经济激励在短期和长期政策影响上存在显著差异。（JEL C93, D83, L94, L98, Q41, Q48）

title: The Economics of Attribute-Based Regulation: Theory and Evidence from Fuel-Economy Standards
abstract: In many countries, fuel-economy standards mandate that vehicles meet a certain fuel economy, but heavier or larger vehicles are allowed to meet a lower standard. This has the perverse implication of allowing automakers to meet standards either by improving fuel economy or by increasing weight, which lowers fuel economy and increases externalities related to accidents. This is but one example of an attribute-based regulation, in which the subsidy, tax or regulation imposed on a product is a function not just of the amount of an externality that the product generates, but also how each product’s externality compares to that of other products deemed to be similar by virtue of a commonality in some other attribute. Such policies are ubiquitous, but the core logic and welfare consequences of their deployment have not been studied by academic economists. This paper develops an analytical framework that captures the central implications of attribute-based policies, characterizes the deadweight loss caused by attribute-basing, and establishes situations in which attribute-basing may be efficient. The paper then empirically examines the consequences of attribute-based fuel economy standards in Japan, where fuel economy standards are an attribute-based function of vehicle weight. We use cross-sectional and panel techniques to demonstrate that attribute-based regulation has significantly altered the distribution of vehicle weight in Japan. We estimate that this alteration generates a welfare loss on the order of $200 per car sold in Japan, which translates into a $1 billion annual loss.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，燃油经济性标准要求车辆达到一定的燃油经济性，但较重或较大的车辆可以达到较低的标准。这带来了一个反常的结果：汽车制造商既可以通过提高燃油经济性来达标，也可以通过增加车重来达标，而后者会降低燃油经济性并增加与事故相关的外部性。这只是基于属性的监管的一个例子，在此类监管中，施加于某一产品的补贴、税收或监管，不仅取决于该产品所产生的外部性数量，还取决于该产品的外部性与其他因某些共同属性而被视为相似的产品相比如何。此类政策无处不在，但其核心逻辑及其实施的福利后果一直未受到经济学学者的研究。本文构建了一个分析框架，以刻画基于属性政策的核心含义，刻画由基于属性所造成的无谓损失，并确定基于属性可能具有效率的情形。随后，本文以日本为例进行了实证检验，日本的燃油经济性标准是车辆重量的基于属性函数。我们运用截面和面板方法证明，基于属性的监管显著改变了日本的车重分布。我们估计，这种改变造成的福利损失约为日本每辆售出汽车200美元的量级，换算成每年约为10亿美元的损失。

title: スマートグリッド・エコノミクス (Smart Grid Economics)
データ分析の力 因果関係に迫る思考法 (The Power of Data Analysis)
Sequential Markets, Market Power and Arbitrage
abstract: We develop a framework to characterize strategic behavior in sequential markets under imperfect competition and restricted entry in arbitrage. Our theory predicts that these two elements can generate a systematic price premium. We test the model predictions using microdata from the Iberian electricity market. We show that the observed price differences and firm behavior are consistent with the model. Finally, we quantify the welfare effects of arbitrage using a structural model. In the presence of market power, we show that full arbitrage is not necessarily welfare-enhancing, reducing consumer costs but increasing deadweight loss. (JEL D42, D43, L12, L13, L94, Q41)
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个框架，用于刻画在不完全竞争和套利进入受限条件下，连续市场中的战略行为。我们的理论预测，这两个要素可以产生系统性的价格溢价。我们利用伊比利亚电力市场的微观数据检验了模型的预测。我们表明，观察到的价格差异和企业行为与模型一致。最后，我们利用结构模型量化了套利的福利效应。在存在市场势力的情况下，我们表明，完全套利未必能增进福利：它降低了消费者成本，却增加了无谓损失。（JEL D42, D43, L12, L13, L94, Q41）

title: Asymmetric Incentives in Subsidies: Evidence from a Large-Scale Electricity Rebate Program
abstract: Many countries use substantial public funds to subsidize reductions in negative externalities. However, such subsidies create asymmetric incentives because increases in externalities remain unpriced. This paper examines implications of such asymmetric subsidy incentives by using a regression discontinuity design in California's electricity rebate program that provided a financial reward for energy conservation. Using household-level panel data from administrative records, I find precisely-estimated zero causal effects in coastal areas. In contrast, the incentive produced a 5% consumption reduction in inland areas. Income and climate conditions significantly drive the heterogeneity. Asymmetric subsidy structures weaken incentives because consumers far from the rebate target show little response. The overall program cost is 17.5 cents per kWh reduction and $390 per ton of carbon dioxide reduction, which is unlikely to be cost-effective for a reasonable range of the social marginal cost of electricity.
abstract_zh: 许多国家动用大量公共资金补贴负外部性的削减。然而，此类补贴会产生不对称的激励，因为外部性的增加仍未被定价。本文利用加州电力返还计划的断点回归设计考察了此类不对称补贴激励的含义，该计划为节约能源提供了经济奖励。利用行政记录中的家庭层面面板数据，我发现沿海地区的因果效应被精确估计为零。相比之下，该激励使内陆地区的用电量减少了5%。收入和气候条件显著地驱动了这种异质性。不对称的补贴结构削弱了激励，因为远离返还目标的消费者几乎没有反应。该计划的总成本为每减少一千瓦时用电17.5美分，每减少一吨二氧化碳390美元，在社会电力边际成本的合理范围内，这一成本不太可能具有成本效益。

title: Do Consumers Respond to Marginal or Average Price? Evidence from Nonlinear Electricity Pricing
abstract: Nonlinear pricing and taxation complicate economic decisions by creating multiple marginal prices for the same good. This paper provides a framework to uncover consumers’ perceived price of nonlinear price schedules. I exploit price variation at spatial discontinuities in electricity service areas, where households in the same city experience substantially different nonlinear pricing. Using household-level panel data from administrative records, I find strong evidence that consumers respond to average price rather than marginal or expected marginal price. This suboptimizing behavior makes nonlinear pricing unsuccessful in achieving its policy goal of energy conservation and critically changes the welfare implications of nonlinear pricing. (JEL D12, L11, L94, L98, Q41)
abstract_zh: 非线性定价和税收会因同一商品存在多个边际价格而使经济决策复杂化。本文提供了一个框架，用以揭示消费者对非线性价格表所感知的价格。我利用电力服务区空间断点处的价格变化，在这些断点两侧，同一城市的家庭面临的非线性定价存在显著差异。利用行政记录中的家庭层面面板数据，我发现有力证据表明，消费者对平均价格而非边际价格或预期边际价格作出反应。这种次优化行为使非线性定价在实现节能这一政策目标上难以成功，并从根本上改变了非线性定价的福利含义。（JEL D12, L11, L94, L98, Q41）

title: International Spillover Effects of Air Pollution: Evidence from Mortality and Health Data
abstract: International transboundary air pollution poses a significant threat to the global economy and health, yet conventional economic analyses seldom incorporate this phenomenon. By integrating transboundary particle trajectory data with individual-level mortality and emergency department visit records, we find that air pollution from China significantly increases mortality and morbidity in South Korea. We evaluate the spillover benefits of recent Chinese environmental regulations and find that a country's environmental policies could generate substantial hidden benefits for neighboring countries. Finally, we demonstrate that China's potentially strategic reductions in pollution could have undermined these benefits, highlighting the implications for additional gains through Coasian bargaining.
abstract_zh: 跨国界的大气污染对全球经济和健康构成重大威胁，然而传统经济分析很少纳入这一现象。通过将跨界颗粒物轨迹数据与个体层面的死亡率和急诊就诊记录相结合，我们发现，来自中国的大气污染显著提高了韩国的死亡率和发病率。我们评估了中国近期环境规制的溢出效益，发现一国的环境政策可能为邻国带来大量隐性收益。最后，我们证明，中国可能出于战略考虑而进行的污染减排，可能削弱这些收益，这凸显了通过科斯式谈判（Coasian bargaining）获取额外收益的意义。

title: Renewable Energy Expansion: Key Challenges and Emerging Opportunities
abstract: The global expansion of renewable energy is key to addressing climate change. After a decade of dramatic cost reductions—especially for solar photovoltaics and wind—renewables now approach cost parity with fossil generation. While this cost reduction has led to a steep increase in solar and wind power in several countries, the global share of solar and wind generation remains modest—approximately 15% as of 2023. This article reviews recent economic studies and identifies three central challenges and corresponding opportunities for scaling up renewable energy—underdeveloped regulatory and market design, insufficient intertemporal market integration, and inadequate spatial market integration. The insights from this review highlight effective ways to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 可再生能源的全球扩张是应对气候变化的关键。经过十年的成本大幅下降，尤其是太阳能光伏和风能的成本下降，可再生能源如今已接近与化石发电平价。尽管这一成本下降已使若干国家的太阳能和风电快速增长，但截至2023年，太阳能和风能发电在全球所占份额仍然较小，约为15%。本文回顾了近期的经济学研究，并指出了扩大可再生能源规模的三项核心挑战及相应机遇：监管和市场设计欠发达、跨期市场一体化不足，以及空间市场一体化不足。本综述的见解突出了加速全球向可再生能源转型的有效途径。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户及发展中国家的居民可以在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。
